sloka: न हि तत् पुरुष व्याघ्रः दुह्खदम् दर्शनम् पितुः ।मातुः च सहितुम् शक्तः तोत्र अर्दितैव द्विपः ॥२-४०-४२॥
transliteration: na hi tat puruṣa vyāghraḥ duhkhadam darśanam pituḥ ।mātuḥ ca sahitum śaktaḥ totra arditaiva dvipaḥ ॥2-40-42॥

translations.english: Rama the best among men, could not, like an elephant tormented by the goad, endure that pitiful sight of his father and mother.
